properties.name: High percentage of clients connecting without PQC support
properties.description:
Identifies PQC Proxy instances where more than 50% of TLS handshakes in the last 24 hours
used classical (non-PQC) key exchange because clients did not offer any post-quantum groups.
This is an adoption tracking signal - these clients are not protected against
harvest-now-decrypt-later attacks. Consider requiring client TLS library upgrades or
communicating PQC requirements to connecting services.
properties.query:
PQCProxy_CL
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
| where EventType == "handshake"
| summarize Total = count(), Classical = countif(QuantumPosture == "classical") by ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId
| where Classical * 100.0 / Total > 50
| extend ClassicalPct = round(100.0 * Classical / Total, 1)
| project ProxyHost, ProxyInstanceId, Total, Classical, ClassicalPct
| order by ClassicalPct desc
